items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: She got home, she looked like Tack Annie, the way he'd swat her.

ctx.x: And he was a pimp. (Unintelligible). He beat her up, naturally, you know. Take her around to friends and someone else try to make her, you know. Because they seen him with her they tried to make her. She got home, she looked like Tack Annie, the way he'd swat her. And that kind of ruined her publicity. You don't want someone beat up going in doing a night's work. It's her own fault.
That's a shame. It is, you know.
